Summary: Mechanics test, not canon. Sarah worked until about 23:35 and keyed the last sale herself at 23:32. Mick Hollis did not leave at half ten: he went out to his car, a dark Vauxhall Astra estate, and waited outside with the engine running. Sarah left with him shortly after 23:35. Lorraine sincerely remembers Sarah leaving alone at about eleven: she saw Sarah step outside for a cigarette at 23:00 and, over the years, that became her memory of Sarah leaving. Mick is lying to hide that he was the last person to see her.
